ava (marketing): Quick launch sync  aiming to announce Fri 09:00 PT. Need final changelog, docs URL, benchmark PNGs, webinar CTA, and lead routing. Who can confirm?
mike (eng): Changelog PR ready (PR #523). Will merge tonight. Includes migration steps for header change and a rotation snippet.
teri (product): Ill trigger docs build after merge and post staging link. Will swap to prod after deploy.
ava (marketing): Webinar Tuesday 11:00 PT  30m demo+Q&A. Need one-sentence slide blurbs and 3 benchmark images: p95 latency, cost/1k, tokens/sec.
mike (eng): Exporting SVGs for prod-opt, quantized, and small variants. ETA 16:00 PT.
izzy (sales ops): I'll create "launch_priority24" tag and route to inbound-sdr for 24h. Send final landing URL + UTMs.
docs-bot: Docs deploy queued: staging -> prod in ~2h. CI green.
ava (marketing): Draft announcement language: softened migration note + migration link. Also call out staged rollout. Will post final copy 1h before.
mike (eng): Canary plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 12h. Auto-rollback on errors >1%. We'll post perf smoke 20m before send.
izzy (sales ops): Once prod URL is up Ill validate tagging and send a test lead.
ava (marketing): Perfect. Ill add webinar CTA and UTMs (utm_campaign=redwood_launch_1991, utm_medium=email) and post final assets here before send. :rocket:
